cases: All 42 fixed real-photo inputs: 22 earlier development and 20 additional source photos. Preserve these separate cohorts.
policy: Retain all 22 supported prior crops exactly. For each of the 20 rejections, try the frozen single-point body first, then the frozen two-paper body if no supported projective crop. First supported crop wins; no template-fitting or ground-truth selection.
geometry: Same projective-body.mjs as the completed synthetic experiment, maxSize=650, existing outline/edge thresholds and orientation search. No per-case adjustment.
material: Keep all original learned material fields, source RGB, alignment and valid-pixel rules. No body-mask union, material retraining, or target editing.
solver: Current automatic preset, resolution and ten-second budget; independent exported renderer, paper/feature checks and editable conversion.
comparison: Report baseline versus candidate counts separately from valid fitted/exported masks; inspect all 20 fallback attempts and every new or changed export. A low derived-mask error does not certify crop correctness or hidden material recovery.
limits: Both cohorts are development data; no held-out accuracy claim.
Existing crops remain untouched, so this measures conditional fallback recovery only.
Frozen inference is reused; crop timing excludes model inference.
No neural model or prototype is integrated into the website.
